summary: Iteration 6 backend-only retest of auto-complete-on-edit fix (server.py update_match). All 6 review-request scenarios PASS: team_a winner derivation, team_b winner derivation, tied-score (winner_team_id=null, finished_at set, status=completed), full 12-match cascade (round auto-completes on last match of round, fixture auto-completes on last match of last round), idempotency (subsequent PUT of score_a to already-completed match does NOT clobber winner_team_id or finished_at), and regression for POST /score?side=a still auto-completing and cascading. The previously failing test_auto_complete_on_edit_sets_winner in test_edit_match.py now also PASSES.

minor.issue: Still no Pydantic validation on MatchUpdate: score_a/score_b accept negatives, target_score accepts 0/negative, status accepts any free-form string (should be Literal['scheduled','live','paused','completed']). Same as iteration_5. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Add Field(ge=0) on score_a/score_b, Field(gt=0) on target_score, and Literal on status in MatchUpdate.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_match() (lines 848-867) now correctly mirrors score_point() terminal-state logic — derives winner_team_id from scores, sets finished_at, and cascades _maybe_auto_complete_round + _maybe_auto_complete_fixture. The guard `if m.get('status') == 'completed' and not m.get('winner_team_id')` also guarantees idempotency: subsequent edits to a completed match preserve the original winner and finished_at. Fix is clean and single-responsibility.
Tie handling: when score_a == score_b, winner remains None but status stays 'completed' and finished_at is set — matches spec.
Cascade on edit works identically to cascade on +1 tap; no observed divergence between the two completion paths.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 new tests + previously-red test_auto_complete_on_edit_sets_winner all pass)

seed_data_creation: Created 5 ad-hoc test fixtures (SAMEER vs PRATIK, courts 12-15, target 3-5) during test runs; all deleted at end of each test. One leftover fixture on court 14 (from a previous timed-out run) was manually cleaned up post-run. Verified no residual tournament data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-complete-on-edit fix is complete and verified end-to-end. The full suite tests are slow because they exercise real HTTP + real fixture lifecycles (~40-170s per class). If re-running, prefer running the cascade test in isolation (it takes ~2m45s due to 12-match walk-through). All scenarios from iteration_5's failing HIGH-priority item are now green. Only remaining item is optional Pydantic hardening on MatchUpdate.
rca of the issue: Original iteration_5 bug was a naive field-copy PUT that never derived winner_team_id or cascaded round/fixture completion when status='completed' was sent. Fix in server.py update_match() lines 848-867 adds a post-update block: if the resulting doc has status=='completed' and no winner_team_id, derive winner (team_a_id if score_a>score_b, team_b_id if score_b>score_a, else None for ties), set finished_at, and call _maybe_auto_complete_round + _maybe_auto_complete_fixture. The `not m.get('winner_team_id')` guard also gives idempotency for free — subsequent PUTs to already-completed matches never overwrite the winner. Verified across all 6 review scenarios.
